title: M1 (b): Elemental-on-environment gate — sealed route opened by applying the correct element
description: Second M1 build step (depends on TASK-026 skeleton). Build a REUSABLE elemental gate mechanic per DD-011: a sealed route the player cannot pass until they apply the CORRECT element to an environment object — e.g. freeze a geyser/coolant with Ice into a platform, burn an obstruction with Fire, or energize a dead lift/bridge with Electricity. Wrong element does nothing; correct element opens the route (persistently). Reuse the existing element/projectile/MagicManager systems and the DD-006 element identities; visual color-coding per DD-003. Place ONE concrete instance in sector_01 at the TASK-026 placeholder. Keep it a small reusable scene+script (e.g. scripts/levels/elemental_gate.gd) so M1+ can drop more in. Telegraph which element is required (color/icon).
acceptance_criteria: A reusable elemental-gate component (scene + script) exists and is placed once in sector_01 blocking a route that is otherwise required to progress.
The gate is configurable for which element opens it (Fire/Ice/Electricity) and which environment interaction it represents (freeze/burn/energize), color-coded per DD-003.
Applying the WRONG element leaves the route sealed; applying the CORRECT element opens it and the player can pass; the opened state persists.

GUT tests (tests-first) prove: closed by default; wrong element keeps it closed; correct element opens it; open state lets traversal/passage succeed. Full suite green exit 0 (run multiple times, flake-aware), gdlint clean, no new stderr noise.
